# Exercice 1 : Mesure de l’indice du verre d’un prisme {background-color="#1b3959"}

## Résultat théorique trouvé

Prisme d'angle $\hat{A}$ et d'indice $n$, plongé dans l'air :

- Descartes en $I_1$ : $\sin i_1 = n \sin r_1$
- Géométrie : $\hat{A} = r_1 + r_2$
- Descartes en $I_2$ : $n \sin r_2 = \sin i_2$, possible seulement si $n \sin r_2 \le 1$
- Déviation totale : $D = i_1 + i_2 - A$

Avec les données de l'énoncé : $A = 60°$, $n = 1.60$.

## Transcription en python

```{python}
#| echo: true
import numpy as np

def prisme(i1, n, A):
    """Trajet dans un prisme d'angle A et d'indice n (angles en degrés)."""
    i1 = np.asarray(i1, dtype=float)
    r1 = np.degrees(np.arcsin(np.sin(np.radians(i1)) / n))   # Descartes en I1
    r2 = A - r1                                              # A = r1 + r2
    s = n * np.sin(np.radians(r2))                           # Descartes en I2
    # si s > 1 : réflexion totale en I2, pas de rayon émergent (i2 = NaN)
    i2 = np.where(s <= 1, np.degrees(np.arcsin(np.minimum(s, 1))), np.nan)
    return r1, r2, i2, i1 + i2 - A                           # D = i1 + i2 - A
```

On balaie $i_1$ de 0 à 90°, pour plusieurs verres et plusieurs prismes :

```{python}
#| echo: true
i1 = np.arange(0, 91)              # i1 de 0° à 90° par pas de 1°
n_valeurs = [1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 1.8]
A_valeurs = [40, 50, 60, 70, 80]
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
def js(v):
    return round(float(v), 3) if np.isfinite(v) else None

cols = ["n", "A", "i1", "r1", "r2", "i2", "D"]
table = {c: [] for c in cols}
limites = {c: [] for c in ["n", "A", "i1_lim", "i_m", "D_m"]}
for n in n_valeurs:
    for A in A_valeurs:
        r1, r2, i2, D = prisme(i1, n, A)
        for c, v in zip(cols, [np.full(i1.shape, n), np.full(i1.shape, A), i1, r1, r2, i2, D]):
            table[c] += [js(x) for x in v]
        ell = np.degrees(np.arcsin(1 / n))
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
            i1_lim = np.degrees(np.arcsin(n * np.sin(np.radians(A - ell))))  # NaN si A > 2 ell
        i_m = np.degrees(np.arcsin(n * np.sin(np.radians(A / 2)))) if A <= 2 * ell else np.nan
        limites["n"].append(n)
        limites["A"].append(A)
        limites["i1_lim"].append(js(max(i1_lim, 0.0)) if np.isfinite(i1_lim) else None)
        limites["i_m"].append(js(i_m))
        limites["D_m"].append(js(2 * i_m - A))

ojs_define(prisme=table, limites=limites)
```

## Simulation interactive

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
rows = transpose(prisme)
curve = rows.filter(d => d.A === A && Math.abs(d.n - n) < 1e-6)
cur = curve[Math.round(i1)]
lim = transpose(limites).find(d => d.A === A && Math.abs(d.n - n) < 1e-6)
navy = "#0E3A5C"
blue = "#1274B6"
red = "#B03A2E"
grey = "#8A8A8A"
```

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
diagram = {
  const deg = Math.PI / 180;
  const dir = a => [Math.cos(a * deg), Math.sin(a * deg)];
  const add = (P, u, t) => [P[0] + t * u[0], P[1] + t * u[1]];
  const cross = (a, b) => a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0];

  // Prisme isocèle de côté 1, sommet en haut (coordonnées physiques, y vers le haut)
  const T = [0, Math.cos(A / 2 * deg)];
  const BL = [-Math.sin(A / 2 * deg), 0], BR = [Math.sin(A / 2 * deg), 0];
  const edges = [[T, BL], [BL, BR], [BR, T]];

  // Premier bord du prisme atteint depuis P dans la direction d
  const exit = (P, d) => {
    let best = null;
    for (const [U, V] of edges) {
      const e = [V[0] - U[0], V[1] - U[1]], w = [U[0] - P[0], U[1] - P[1]];
      const den = cross(d, e);
      if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-12) continue;
      const t = cross(w, e) / den, s = cross(w, d) / den;
      if (t > 1e-9 && s > -1e-9 && s < 1 + 1e-9 && (!best || t < best.t)) best = {t, U, p: add(P, d, t)};
    }
    return best;
  };

  // Directions : normale entrante en I1 à -A/2, normale sortante en I2 à +A/2
  const I1 = [(T[0] + BL[0]) / 2, (T[1] + BL[1]) / 2];
  const uIn = dir(-A / 2 + i1);
  const uGlass = dir(-A / 2 + cur.r1);
  const hit = exit(I1, uGlass), I2 = hit.p;
  const onFace2 = hit.U === BR;
  const emerges = onFace2 && Number.isFinite(cur.i2);

  // Passage en coordonnées SVG (cadre fixe : la figure ne saute pas quand A change)
  const x0 = -1.25, yTop = 1.15, sc = 200;
  const W = 2.5 * sc, H = (yTop + 0.55) * sc;
  const X = p => (p[0] - x0) * sc, Y = p => (yTop - p[1]) * sc;
  const P = p => `${X(p).toFixed(1)},${Y(p).toFixed(1)}`;
  const mid = (a, b) => [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2];
  const ray = (a, b) =>
    `<polyline points="${[a, mid(a, b), b].map(P).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2.5" marker-mid="url(#arrow)"/>`;
  const dashed = (a, b, color) =>
    `<line x1="${X(a)}" y1="${Y(a)}" x2="${X(b)}" y2="${Y(b)}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>`;
  const text = (p, s, dx, dy, color = navy) =>
    `<text x="${X(p) + dx}" y="${Y(p) + dy}" fill="${color}" text-anchor="middle">${s}</text>`;

  const parts = [
    `<polygon points="${[T, BL, BR].map(P).join(" ")}" fill="${blue}" fill-opacity="0.12" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2"/>`,
    dashed(add(I1, dir(-A / 2), -0.35), add(I1, dir(-A / 2), 0.35), grey),
    ray(add(I1, uIn, -0.9), I1),
    ray(I1, I2),
    text(T, "A", 0, 34),
    text([0, 0.1], `n = ${n.toFixed(2)}`, 0, 0),
    text(I1, "I<tspan baseline-shift='sub' font-size='14'>1</tspan>", 4, 28)
  ];

  if (onFace2) {
    parts.push(dashed(add(I2, dir(A / 2), -0.35), add(I2, dir(A / 2), 0.35), grey));
    parts.push(text(I2, "I<tspan baseline-shift='sub' font-size='14'>2</tspan>", -4, 28));
  }

  if (emerges) {
    const uOut = dir(A / 2 - cur.i2);
    parts.push(ray(I2, add(I2, uOut, 0.9)));
    // Déviation : angle entre le prolongement du rayon incident et le rayon émergent
    const K = add(I1, uIn, cross([I2[0] - I1[0], I2[1] - I1[1]], uOut) / cross(uIn, uOut));
    const rArc = 0.2, a = add(K, uIn, rArc), b = add(K, uOut, rArc);
    parts.push(dashed(I1, add(K, uIn, 0.4), blue));
    parts.push(dashed(I2, K, blue));
    parts.push(`<path d="M ${P(a)} A ${rArc * sc} ${rArc * sc} 0 0 1 ${P(b)}" fill="none" stroke="${blue}" stroke-width="2"/>`);
    parts.push(text(add(K, dir((i1 - cur.i2) / 2), 0.33), "D", 0, 7, blue));
  } else if (onFace2) {
    const m = dir(A / 2), k = 2 * (uGlass[0] * m[0] + uGlass[1] * m[1]);
    const back = exit(I2, [uGlass[0] - k * m[0], uGlass[1] - k * m[1]]);
    if (back) parts.push(ray(I2, back.p));
    parts.push(text([0.75, 1.0], "réflexion totale en I₂", 0, 0, red));
  } else {
    parts.push(text([0.75, 1.0], "le rayon atteint la base", 0, 0, red));
  }

  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}"
      style="max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:20px">
    <defs><marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="${navy}"/></marker></defs>
    ${parts.join("\n")}
  </svg>`;
  return el;
}
```

  const items = !Number.isFinite(lim.i1_lim)

    : [

          : htl.html`<li>${tex`A \le \ell = ${f(ell)}`} : le rayon ressort pour toute incidence.</li>`,
        htl.html`<li>Minimum de déviation ${tex`D_m = ${f(lim.D_m)}`} pour ${tex`i_1 = i_m = ${f(lim.i_m)}`} : trajet symétrique, ${tex`r_1 = r_2 = A/2`}.</li>`,
        lim.i1_lim > 0
          ? htl.html`<li>Retour inverse de la lumière : incidence limite et incidence rasante donnent la même déviation, ${tex`D = ${f(curve[90].D)}`}.</li>`
          : null
      ];
  return htl.html`<div style="font-size:0.5em;margin-top:1em"><p style="margin:0"><b>À observer :</b></p>
    <ul style="display:block;margin:0 0 0 1.2em">${items}</ul></div>`;
}

  const emerging = curve.filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.D));
  const limit = Number.isFinite(lim.i1_lim) ? lim.i1_lim : 90;
  const hasMin = Number.isFinite(lim.D_m);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 580,

    style: {fontSize: "15px"},

    y: {label: "D (°)", labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none", grid: true, nice: true,
        domain: emerging.length ? undefined : [0, 90]},
    marks: [
      limit > 0 ? Plot.rect([{a: 0, b: limit}], {x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: red, fillOpacity: 0.08}) : null,
      limit > 0 ? Plot.text([{x: limit / 2, t: "réflexion\ntotale"}], {x: "x", text: "t", frameAnchor: "middle", fill: red}) : null,
      hasMin ? Plot.ruleY([lim.D_m], {stroke: blue, strokeDasharray: "5,4"}) : null,
      hasMin ? Plot.text([{x: lim.i_m > 45 ? 2 : 88, y: lim.D_m, t: `D_m = ${lim.D_m.toFixed(1)}°`}],
                         {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", dy: -10, textAnchor: lim.i_m > 45 ? "start" : "end", fill: blue}) : null,
      Plot.line(emerging, {x: "i1", y: "D", stroke: navy, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.ruleX([i1], {stroke: grey}),
      Plot.dot(Number.isFinite(cur.D) ? [cur] : [], {x: "i1", y: "D", r: 7, fill: blue, stroke: "white"})
    ]
  });
}
